preconditions.expression: 1 <= n <= 200000 and isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= m <= 200000 and isinstance(m, int)
preconditions.description: n and m are integers within the range [1, 200000]

preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and len(s) == n and all(c.isalnum() for c in s)
preconditions.description: s is a string of length n consisting of alphanumeric characters

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(l, int) and isinstance(r, int) and isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 and c.isalnum() and 1 <= l <= r <= len(s) for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation is a tuple (l, r, c) where l and r are integers with 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ current string length, and c is a single alphanumeric character

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join([s[i-1] for i in range(1, len(s)+1) if not any(l <= i <= r and s[i-1] == c for l, r, c in operations)])
postconditions.description: The output string is the result of removing all characters c in the range [l, r] for each operation (l, r, c) from the original string s, preserving the order of remaining characters
